summary: Extract every nonzero same-color four-connected object. Sort objects by left bounding-box column, breaking ties by top row and then numeric color. Let the chart height be the largest object cell count and its width be twice the object count minus one. For each sorted object, paint one bottom-aligned bar in its color and with height equal to its cell count at the corresponding even output column; keep every odd separator column black.
